voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: The Strait of Malacca. Fifteen eleven. The Portuguese carrack Flor de la Mar set sail, carrying the treasure taken from the Sultan of Malacca's palace.
Off the coast of Sumatra, a storm drove her aground.
Her commander, Afonso de Albuquerque, escaped on a raft. Hundreds of men were lost.
Portugal, Malaysia and Indonesia have all claimed what she carried. Treasure hunters have announced finds. None has been confirmed.
Five centuries on, the ship and her treasure have never been found.
